Its only "social" is a link to someone else's tweet (@MustStopMurad), not its own account. The dev has launched one other coin in their recent history, **$1**, 21 hours ago, and it died at 0% of the curve. Neither of their coins has graduated.

**Verdict:** A low-effort coin riding someone else's tweet, from a dev whose only other launch flopped. With 27% of the supply still in the dev's wallet, this is a momentum trade at best, and it could be dumped on buyers at any moment. 🚩

turns.text:
The buy didn't go through. No wallet is set up on the pump server, so nothing was sent and no SOL was spent.

To enable trading, add one of these to the pump MCP server's environment settings, then restart it:
- `PUMP_WALLET_KEY`: your wallet's private key in base58
- `PUMP_WALLET_FILE`: the path to a Solana CLI keypair file

The keypair file is the safer choice, ideally a burner wallet with only a small amount of SOL in it. Also, BAH was moving quickly, so its price will have changed by the time the wallet is ready. Once it's set up, tell me whether you still want the buy and I'll check the coin again before placing it.
